nodes.title: Note: s01-dance-v2-noturbo-20step
widgets_values:
## S01 dance v2 - TURBO DISABLED, 20 steps (Variant B)

**This is the controlled experiment for "is the 4-step turbo LoRA the bottleneck?"**

Variant B is byte-identical to Variant A except for one switch:

- **"Boolean (Enable Lightning LoRA)" = FALSE**

That single flag does two things at once (both switches are wired to it):
- model path -> the raw GGUF, **no turbo LoRA**
- step count -> **20** (from the node "Int (Full)")

### How to read the result
Compare against Variant A with the same script:
`python <skills>/ai-video-artifact-forensics/scripts/analyze_video.py --video A --ref S101.png`

| Outcome | Conclusion |
|---|---|
| lapvar roughly the same, artifacts roughly the same | 4-step turbo is NOT the bottleneck; the remaining gap is framing/scene/prompt |
| lapvar clearly higher, artifacts clearly fewer | turbo was a real ceiling; budget the time for 20 steps or a higher quant |

### Cost warning
20 steps is ~5x the sampling work of 4 steps on top of an already CPU-offloaded 15.6 GB
Q3_K_M weight. Expect this to be slow. If it OOMs or crawls, drop to 352x608 first to get a
cheap answer, then decide.

### Also worth an A/B
Keep turbo ON at 8 steps but set the scheduler back to `simple`, to isolate whether `beta`
helps at 8 steps. That is a 2-minute edit versus re-running 20 steps.

Same woman as <Picture 1>. Keep her identity exactly as shown: pale skin, red eyes, long wavy black hair, and exactly two glossy black horns with red tips - two horns only, nothing else protrudes from her head or her hair. Her hair is smooth and lies flat against her head with no extra horn shapes.

Wardrobe exactly as in <Picture 1>: black high-waisted shorts with a chain belt, sheer black thigh-high stockings, black ankle-strap stiletto heels, and short black gloves ending at the wrist. Do not lengthen the gloves and do not add any garment that is not visible in <Picture 1>.

Set: a bright, seamless light-grey studio. Plain flat untextured background with no folds and no patterns, and an even light-grey floor with no seam lines and no reflections. Nothing else in the room.

Lighting: completely even flat frontal lighting with no shadow side and no rim light. The whole image is bright and high-key, matching <Picture 1>. Her skin stays clean, bright and evenly lit across her whole body.

Camera: locked-off tripod, fixed wide full-body framing from horns to heels, eye level, 35mm look, deep focus. Her whole body, including both hands, stays fully inside the frame at all times with clear margin from all four edges.

Choreography, a restrained K-pop girl-group routine that keeps her arms close to her body:
[0.0s-1.0s] She stands at centre in a low ready stance, weight on the back leg, chin up, one hand resting near her hip. She takes a slow visible breath.
[1.0s-2.2s] Two crisp hip isolations to her right, then a small side-step-together step, her heels striking the floor on the beat. Her arms stay low and relaxed.
[2.2s-3.4s] She raises one hand to frame her cheek, holds it, then lowers it slowly. The other hand stays near her waist. Both hands remain well inside the frame.
[3.4s-4.2s] A gentle shoulder roll travelling one small step to her left, hair swinging with natural follow-through. She glances over her shoulder and turns back to front.
[4.2s-5.17s] She returns to centre, sweeps her hair back off one shoulder with a single small hand movement, settles into a grounded final pose, and holds it with a faint confident smile.

Both hands are open with the fingers together and clearly five fingers each. Her arms stay close to her torso and never spread outward. Her feet stay on the floor, her body stays entirely within the frame, and her movement is smooth and continuous.

Audio: an upbeat dance-pop backing track, four-on-the-floor kick, bright synth-brass stabs on the off-beats, a simple female vocal hook, plus the soft click of her heels on the floor. No dialogue, no crowd noise.

No camera movement, no cuts, no zoom, no slow motion. No extra fingers, no extra limbs, no duplicated arms, no extra horns, no fur or feathers on the horns, no wings, no tail, no second person, no text, no logos, no watermarks, no subtitles, no outfit changes.

nodes.title: Note: Size Settings (portrait)
widgets_values:
| megapixels | Aspect | Output (multiple=32) |
|---|---|---|
| 0.2 | 9:16 | 352 x 608 |
| 0.3 | 9:16 | 416 x 736 |
| 0.4 | 9:16 | 480 x 864 |
| **0.98** | **9:16** | **768 x 1344** |

v2 uses **0.98 MP / 9:16 = 768x1344** (output is 1.032 MP after rounding to 32).
Reference is pre-padded to 768x1344 so `ref_image_size: match` is a no-op.
